additional_info.subject: Charger MP/R8 – No. 170002535 in Error Mode (Power Sensor Reading Failure)
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support Team,
I would like to report a recurring issue on charger
SICGARGE MP / R8 – No. 170002535
, which is currently in
error mode
.
The message displayed is as follows:
Power sensor reading failure
Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1223421108 status)
Last status update:
30/10/2025 at 08:04:51
This issue has been
very repetitive
and has
been penalizing the use of this charger for some time
, affecting its availability.
Please
analyze the root cause and propose a permanent corrective action
to prevent the recurrence of this fault.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485

additional_info.subject: ID0458873-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R8 170002535] Error on LEM DC Meter CRM:02681001010
additional_info.body:
Dear
Malek DRIF
,
After our check and analysis, as shown in the screenshot log, the
“Error on LEM DC Meter”
was caused by a temporary communication loss between the LEM DC meter and the NTP server. It has been identified as a bug.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
